scope: Read-only feasibility of a separately frozen retrospective learned-checkpoint dynamical panel. No checkpoint/NPZ was opened, no inference or test was run, and the constructed seven-case plan was not changed.

reconstruction.safe_loading: torch.load(path,map_location='cpu',weights_only=True); compare configuration with configuration.json and run.json, then load_state_dict(strict=True).
reconstruction.nonpersistent_buffers: g_rgb and g_mask are not in state_dict. This recipe uses grounded=None and no grounding mutation, so constructor zeros restore them; verify and record these values explicitly.
reconstruction.dependencies: The native model class and Torch suffice for inference. No ResearchNCA, phase3, task generator, optimizer or historical training driver must run.

selection.source_based_expected_context: Validation is rendered for base only, ordered bag→event→role. These four rows therefore correspond to roles0,1,2,3 of event0 in the first validation bag.
selection.required_admission: Confirm stored role/query_event/group_index/condition_index/record_id and canvas arrays before any continuation. This is one fixed scene, not four independent content groups.
selection.saved_prediction_arrays: logits float32, pred, nll float64, target, role, group_index and record_id. The corresponding per-seed validation_predictions.npz exists for all five checkpoints.

runtime.prospective_change: If current item15 Python3.12.14 and CPU1 are used, record them as a runtime migration rather than exact historical runtime reproduction.
runtime.reference_gate: Before extended trajectories, match selected T16 logits/predictions to saved validation outputs using a prospectively frozen tolerance. Reproduce the original64-row evaluation batch containing indices0–3 for this compatibility gate to avoid an unnecessary batch-shape change. Preserve measured discrepancies and stop the new panel if its gate fails.

storage_and_cost.prospective_bounds: One checkpoint at a time, CPU1/interop1, RAM admission and supervision >=8GiB, fixed256 continuation limit, maximum absolute state1e12 plus finite checks. A120-second compute cap for the small panel is plausible from operation counts, but has not been timed; reserve separate bounded recovery, audit and archival time.
storage_and_cost.trace_guard_policy: Preserve the first threshold/nonfinite observation and all preceding states, with per-trajectory termination time and reason. Do not silently clip states, switch dtype, discard a checkpoint or treat missing later horizons as stable.
storage_and_cost.interpretation: Any paired gain is directional and finite-time, not the operator norm or a global Lipschitz bound; low-competence checkpoints may still support a dynamical diagnosis without demonstrating useful memory.

limits: Checkpoint and dataset binary formats are inferred from exact source and authenticated descriptors, not independently deserialized in this review.
Five checkpoint seeds and four fixed query inputs do not establish universal architecture stability or generalization over scenes.
The NPZ byte SHA and canonical canvas/target content SHA are different identities and must not be interchanged.
Source-held continuation measures driven recurrence. Changing or removing inputs would be another intervention requiring its own declared interpretation.
The separately frozen panel remains proposed; this receipt authorizes no job, training, reference change or next-item work.
